name: Fundamentals of Instructing (FOI)
about: The Fundamentals of Instructing that any flight instructor checkride can test: the seven FOI Tasks of the CFII Practical Test Standards (FAA-S-8081-9E, Area I), taught from the Aviation Instructor's Handbook (FAA-H-8083-9B). Good preparation for the FOI knowledge test and for the CFI and CFII courses.
